description: Casts a 'yes' vote for a specified member on a Trello card; a member can only vote once per card.

idCard.description: The ID of the card to add the vote to. Must be the full 24-character card ID, not a short link. For example, `571d07b591c8b68aeb4f6acc`.
idCard.title: Id Card

value.description: The ID of the member to cast a 'yes' vote on the card. Must be a valid 24-character member ID. Note: Voting must be enabled on the board for this action to succeed.
value.title: Value

name: add_card_vote

members.description: Array of member objects representing users who have voted on the card
members.title: Members

Member.description: A Trello member object representing a user who has voted on the card

avatarUrl.description: The url of this member's avatar
avatarUrl.title: Avatar Url

confirmed.description: Whether the user has confirmed their email address for their account
confirmed.title: Confirmed

fullName.description: The full name related to the account, if it is public
fullName.title: Full Name

idBoards.description: List of boards this member belongs to
idBoards.title: Id Boards

idOrganizations.description: List of workspaces this member belongs to
idOrganizations.title: Id Organizations

initials.description: The initials related to the account, if it is public
initials.title: Initials

Member.title: Member
